this work is an attempt to show the importance of the semiotic approach as a methodology for the design and application of criteria for evaluation of learning in Physics, through the analysis of different symbolic elements that represent mainly the concepts of Physics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of the symbolic analysis as a tool to evaluate the learning of Physics is a very useful method to know the level of learning of the student, since this method is based on the analysis and interpretation of different symbolic elements that represent fundamental concepts of Physics.

the evaluation of learning in physics is based on the analysis of the symbolic elements that represent the concepts of physics, which are established by means of conventions of communication that represent the experience of learning of the students through multiple representations.

the analysis of semiotics as a tool for evaluating learning in physics teaching was based on a constructivist view of the teaching-learning process, where students' learning is considered a process of construction of meanings.
The main takeaway from our work is that
students' understanding of concepts can be evaluated by analyzing the different symbols that represent them.
